key_catalyst: Nvidia's reported $250B OpenAI data-center guarantee, reviving AI circular-financing concerns
reasoning: The reported $250B Nvidia backstop is a novel escalation of the AI-return concerns that drove QQQ lower on July 23-24, because it raises direct questions about whether supplier-financed demand is sustaining the AI spending cycle. It arrives alongside rising rate-hike expectations and unresolved earnings risk, while the pre-market decline suggests those concerns are still being repriced rather than resolved.
